_comment: Known-good hashes for every JPEG under references/libjpeg-turbo/testimages/. Written by tests/worker_b3_reference_image_hashes.rs. Hash algorithm: std::hash::DefaultHasher (SipHash-1-3) over the decoded pixel buffer (Rgb for 8-bit fixtures, raw i16 little-endian samples for 12-bit fixtures). To regenerate after an intentional decoder change: UPDATE_HASHES=1 cargo test --test worker_b3_reference_image_hashes -- --nocapture.
